headline: Great Britain Energy Bills Forecast to Rise 26% from January
summary: Energy bills across Great Britain are predicted to reach £2,166 per year for typical households from January as Middle East conflict drives costs, while UK inflation reached 3.6%.
why: Regulated domestic energy prices in Great Britain influence consumer spending capacity and broader national retail price inflation.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: Sharply higher utility bills increase headline inflation and strain household discretionary spending.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
